honesty.banner: Sample / demo country intelligence — not a live news or risk feed. Profiles use structural public-domain context and illustrative scenarios. They are not current-event reports.
honesty.confidenceRules: Observed is reserved for established structural facts. Predictive risks and citizen-impact links must never use Observed. Missing or invalid confidence defaults to Unknown.
honesty.currentEventsRules: Current Events entries are labeled sample/demo structural context or historical patterns — never presented as live breaking news.
